text.arabic_uthmani: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنًۭا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: temporal hinge pointing back to the prior consequence and forward into the concrete rumor scene
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) opens the ayah as a temporal hinge. It reaches back to the prior averted consequence in 24:14 and names the concrete time when the rumor was being taken up, spoken, and misjudged. The particle therefore makes the ayah an exposure of the conduct behind the spared punishment, with temporal location carrying causal pressure.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah as the timed exposure of conduct that explains the prior averted consequence in 24:14.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: active communal reception of the already-known slander as a circulating object, with relay pressure under a past temporal frame
words.root_gloss_range: meeting, receiving, taking up, and casting in related forms; locally Form V selects active communal uptake and relay of a received object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: temporal particle anchoring the reception under the past explanatory frame

words.prose: {{ar:تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ}} ({{tr:talaqqawnahu}}) makes culpability begin at uptake. The Form V imperfect under {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:idh}}) presents active communal receiving, not one completed accidental hearing. Its attached object keeps the slander moving as a known pronoun, while the following tongue-instrument phrase turns reception itself into the first oral beat. Variant evidence keeps the receive-transmit axis visible without replacing the canonical form, and dignified reception echoes elsewhere (2:37; 7:22; 28:86) are inverted here because the received object is slander.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 2
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that culpability begins with active communal uptake and relay before overt speech.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: instrumental and channel-marking preposition that oralizes even the act of reception
words.prose: The first {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the tongues the means and channel of reception. It prevents the first action from sounding private or purely mental: the rumor is received through the very speech organ. Because a second {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) appears with mouths, the preposition also starts a structural mirror between receiving-with-tongues and saying-with-mouths.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 3
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even reception is oralized through a bodily speech channel.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural tongues as the addressees own speech-faculties and instruments of reception
words.root_gloss_range: tongue, speech, language, and pointed expression; locally the possessed plural names the addressees own tongue-faculties as the receiving channel
words.prose: {{ar:أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ}} ({{tr:alsinatikum}}) is not a generic body-part image. It is genitive after the instrument marker and bound to the addressed group, so the ayah assigns the channel of uptake to their own plural tongues. The word keeps both organ and language-faculty in view; the pointed or sharp-edged tongue pressure makes the transmission feel cutting rather than neutral, and it already separates verbal capacity from knowledge. Echoes of tongues tied to false description (16:116) and later testimony by tongues in this passage (24:24) sharpen the speech-warning field.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 4
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressees own tongues as plural instruments of uptake, speech-faculty, and future witness.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector binding reception and saying under one temporal frame without collapsing them
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the receiving action to the saying action under the same temporal frame. It keeps the two actions parallel and close without making them one verb or forcing a strict micro-order: the ayah can make reception and speech overlap as live circulation while still first naming uptake, then output. Its fusion to the next verb also makes the transition feel immediate.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 5
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reception and saying as linked actions in one scene while still remaining distinct steps.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: ongoing plural utterance of unverified content, moving rumor from intake into public speech
words.root_gloss_range: saying, uttering, claiming, and reported speech; locally Form I selects raw communal utterance rather than verified testimony
words.prose: {{ar:تَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:taqūlūna}}) turns the intake chain into output. The imperfect plural form sustains communal speech, while the following relative clause with no knowledge prevents the utterance from becoming testimony. Form I keeps the action as raw saying, but the nearby fabricated-speech family, including the warning at 69:44, sharpens the danger of claim-production without changing the local stem. In the surahs speech-ethics arc, this hollow saying contrasts with corrected or validated speech later in the passage.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 6
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees public saying tested by the no-knowledge clause, not elevated into testimony.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: instrumental mouth-channel marker with restrictive force: the speech is located at the oral outlet
words.prose: The second {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marks the mouths as the instrument of saying. Its force is more restrictive than decorative: the speech is located at the output channel, while the no-knowledge clause denies inward warrant. One local parse lets the mouth phrase frame the whole oral relay, so the reception-output sequence is oralized, not only the second verb. Because the same preposition already marked tongues, this word completes the matched instrument frame.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 7
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices speech reduced to an oral channel without the knowledge that would validate it.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural mouths as concrete outlets of speech separated from epistemic warrant
words.root_gloss_range: mouth, mouth-opening, and oral emission; locally the possessed plural makes the addressees physical mouths the speech outlets
words.prose: {{ar:أَفْوَاهِكُم}} ({{tr:afwāhikum}}) makes the second speech organ concrete. It is governed by the instrument marker and possessed by the addressees, so the ayah counts many physical outlets of speech rather than leaving the utterance abstract. The root image of mouth-opening and emission narrows the action to exposed output, especially once the next clause denies knowledge. Concrete parallels where mouths say what is not inwardly true (3:167; 9:30) help show why this phrase matters here.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 8
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees many addressee-owned mouths as accountable outlets separated from inward warrant.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: relative object marker that turns what they say into a clause defined by absent knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:مَّا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies the object content of the speech verb. It does not merely point to a topic; it opens the relative clause that defines what they are saying as something for which no knowledge exists. Its generalizing force lets the whole content be drawn into that epistemic negation.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 9
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the object of saying as a clause whose content is immediately judged by absent knowledge.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: categorical negation of knowledge-existence, not merely a softer denial of action
words.root_gloss_range: negated being and non-existence through the defective verb; locally it makes knowledge categorically absent
words.prose: {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) is the negative hinge inside what they say. As a defective verb of negation, it denies the existence of knowledge for them rather than merely saying they failed to act on it. The added topic phrase and final knowledge noun make the center of the ayah epistemic: mouths are speaking into a categorical void before the ayah moves to their false reckoning.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 10
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes categorical absence of knowledge at the structural center of the ayah.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: possessive/dative phrase denying the addressees any ownership of the needed knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) makes the missing knowledge a denied possession of the addressed group. The same plural address that owned the tongues and mouths now appears where knowledge should have belonged. Its placement before the knowledge noun delays the warrant and makes the denial of ownership explicit before the absent thing is named.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 11
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees warrant framed as something the speakers do not possess.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: resumptive topic phrase and emphatic complement that specifies what no knowledge exists about

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: possessive/dative phrase denying the addressees ownership of knowledge

words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) resumes the spoken matter inside the no-knowledge clause. The preposition and pronoun specify exactly what the missing knowledge concerns, while the post-negation phrase intensifies the denial. Together with {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}), it stages possession first and topic second before the knowledge noun finally arrives.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 12
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same spoken content back into the knowledge test through the resumptive pronoun.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: indefinite knowledge-warrant denied under negation, closing the speech-content clause
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, verified knowledge, signs, instruction, and disclosure; locally the indefinite verbal noun names the warrant whose existence is denied
words.prose: {{ar:عِلْمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿilmun}}) is the thing whose existence has been denied. As an indefinite verbal noun under negation, it makes the absence broad: not even a unit of real warrant stands behind the speech. Its lexical field points to verified knowing, signs, teaching, and informing, so the ayah is not asking for a mood of certainty but for an actual epistemic basis. This word closes the relative object clause, then the ayah moves from evidentiary failure to false evaluation. The wider no-knowledge warning field includes concrete restraints at 10:36, 17:36, and 53:28.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 13
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that no real item of verified knowledge stands behind the speech.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: cumulative coordinator that adds the appraisal clause as a third action in the sequence
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the appraisal clause to the chain. It keeps reception, speech, and reckoning in one cumulative series rather than subordinating the later error as a mere explanation. The fused connector makes the third action arrive as the next link in the same offense.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 14
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees misreckoning added as a further act in the same sequence, not as detached commentary.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: communal reckoning or supposing of the same matter as light, with calculation and appraisal pressure
words.root_gloss_range: reckoning, supposing, calculating, and accounting; locally the verb selects communal appraisal of the same object
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْسَبُونَهُۥ}} ({{tr:taḥsabūnahu}}) changes the fault from transmission to valuation. The same object pronoun keeps the slander in view, while the verb takes a second predicate: they reckon it light. Its root keeps supposition and calculation close, so the act is not only a mistaken feeling but an accounting error. That reckoning is prepared for reversal by the final divine scale, and the same passage has already warned against misreckoning the affair (24:11).

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 15
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the false appraisal as miscalculation that prepares the divine scale correction.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: false low-severity predicate assigned to the matter before the divine counter-scale overturns it
words.root_gloss_range: ease, lightness, low valuation, and abasement; locally the accusative adjective names the false low-severity value assigned to the matter
words.prose: {{ar:هَيِّنًۭا}} ({{tr:hayyinan}}) names the false value assigned by their reckoning. As an indefinite accusative second predicate, it is the communitys label for the matter, not the ayahs verdict. The root family lets ease, lightness, low valuation, and abasement press together, and the intensive adjective pattern sharpens the minimization, so the low estimate is morally charged. Its force depends on the coming reversal: human lightness stands opposite the final divine greatness.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 16
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees lightness as a value they assign to the matter, ready to be overturned.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial connector introducing the simultaneous divine counter-judgment
words.prose: The final {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces the counter-state while their reckoning is still in view. As circumstantial connection, it makes the correction simultaneous: they are counting it light while it already stands, with God, as great. The connector also pivots from the second-person chain to an objectified third-person verdict.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 17
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the divine assessment as simultaneous with the human misreckoning, not as a later afterthought.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: detached pronoun that stabilizes the same matter or whole affair as subject of a standing verdict
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) stabilizes the subject of the final nominal judgment. After a chain of attached object pronouns, the detached pronoun holds the matter out as something to be assessed in itself. Its reference can include the slander or the whole affair, but the local function is clear: it freezes the subject before the divine-locus phrase and the final predicate.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 18
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the matter separated from the action chain and held as the subject of judgment.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: construct evaluative locus before God, carrying proximity into divine standard and measure
words.root_gloss_range: nearness, presence, possession or withness, estimation, and some obstinacy branches; locally it becomes a divine evaluative locus in construct
words.prose: {{ar:عِنْدَ}} ({{tr:ʿinda}}) locates the final assessment in Gods domain. Bound in construct to the divine name, it makes the standard definite before the magnitude word appears. The spatial sense of nearness and presence becomes an evaluative measure: the matter is not only socially discussed but stands before God. The root-family pressure around right measure and obstinacy stays narrowed, but it still makes the divine locus answer the communitys deviating calculation. Its placement before the final adjective lets the reader hear whose scale counts before hearing the verdict itself.

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 19
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the standard of judgment established before the final word names magnitude.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the genitive complement that makes the final scale definite and authoritative
words.root_gloss_range: the divine-name field with worship, refuge, and disputed derivational associations; locally the proper name fixes the unique divine standard
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) completes the evaluative phrase as a proper divine name in genitive construct. The final measure is therefore not generic religious authority or social reputation; it is anchored to God as the named standard-setter. Derivational fields of worship, refuge, and bewilderment remain background pressure, because the local form is the proper name inside the scale phrase. The phrase also belongs to a larger formula in which grave matters register with God (2:217; 42:22), and within Surah 24 it contrasts hollow speech here with later speech claims and validated response (24:47; 24:51).

topics.headline: integrated payoff for word 20
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final scale anchored in the named divine authority rather than an unspecified evaluator.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cohere with the local grammar and reference evidence as a word-level payoff; no row is contradicted by the guardrails, so the rows are preserved under one integrated topic.

words.gloss_range: final predicate of immense moral gravity, overturning the communitys light valuation
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, magnitude, rank, weight, and structural imagery; locally the adjective assigns moral gravity before God

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: false low-severity value assigned by the human reckoning

words.prose: {{ar:عَظِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿaẓīmun}}) is the ayahs landing word. As the nominative predicate of the final nominal sentence, indefinite and final in position, it gives the matter an open-ended magnitude before God. The root family can move from structure and weight to moral greatness, so the slander-affair is made structurally grave rather than socially light. It directly overturns {{ar:هَيِّنًۭا}} ({{tr:hayyinan}}): the communitys low valuation is answered by divine immensity. The boundary echoes matter too, since the greatness root moves from averted punishment in 24:14 to the offense itself here, and the corrected-perception frame also resonates with 24:11.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayahs central scalar reversal: what they deemed light is immense with God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم ... مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The syntax routes the report from reception directly to tongue and mouth while explicitly denying epistemic possession; the organ of output has become the receiving surface, so circulation outruns cognition.

activation_trace.role: Taking up and learning speech supplies the intake stage of the relay.
The tongue as speech organ is made, unusually, the stated surface of reception.
Bringing words out in speech supplies immediate retransmission.
Opening the mouth in speech supplies the relay's outlet.
Knowledge as disclosure to a knower is negated, marking the skipped checkpoint.

changed_reading.after: You became a nearly frictionless oral relay: the report landed on the speaking organ and exited through the mouth before becoming knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ ... بِأَفْوَاهِكُم ... لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Tongue, mouth, and absent knowledge form a staged anatomy: language occupies an external organ and passes an aperture, while the inward, unexpressed or knowing stage is missing.

activation_trace.role: Tongue as language, report, and circulating speech supplies the verbal surface.
The mouth as an opening or outlet turns speech into exterior discharge.
The branch of unexpressed inner speech supplies the interior stage whose epistemic equivalent is absent here.
Present-state negation seals the lack of inward knowledge.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the missing interior possession.

changed_reading.before: Tongues and mouths are redundant emphases for speaking.
changed_reading.after: The doubled anatomy diagrams exterior speech without an interior warrant: language reaches the outlet while knowledge never becomes present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَتَحْسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنًۭا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: A subjective estimate assigns lightness or ease, then the construction relocates the same act into God's evaluative presence and gives it magnitude; the contrast is not only emotion but a clash of measures.

activation_trace.role: Supposition supplies the fallible private estimate.
Counting and calculation give that estimate the functional shape of valuation.
Lightness and ease supply the low human valuation.
Presence and standing at a locus supply the alternate divine forum.
Greatness and force supply the weight that overturns the human estimate.

changed_reading.before: You underestimated how serious the statement was.
changed_reading.after: You priced the utterance on a private scale as nearly weightless, while in the divine forum it already had force and magnitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: The legal sequence casts accusation as a verbal projectile and testimony as declaration grounded in knowledge. The focus speech therefore functions as de facto accusation or testimony that entered circulation without the required evidentiary carrier and is classified in the same divine forum.

activation_trace.role: Saying what did not occur or attributing it to another anchors the focus speech as allegation.
Knowledge is the expressly absent warrant.
Verbal casting supplies the projectile mechanism of accusation.
Declaration based on knowledge supplies the evidentiary threshold that the focus speech lacks.
Standing in God's presence repeats the forum that later measures the focus utterance.
Contradiction of truth supplies the verdict when witnesses are absent.

structural_cues: Ayat 24:4 and 24:13 bracket the allegation with a four-witness requirement and the verdict `عند الله ... الكاذبون`; 24:15 repeats the divine forum after naming knowledge as absent.
The focus moves from oral handling to divine valuation inside a passage that has already formalized admissible speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verbal throwing, knowledge-based testimony, failed witnesses, and the repeated divine forum; I infer that circulating the report performs an informal accusation. A live alternative is that 24:15 rebukes social repetition outside the formal testimonial act.

changed_reading.before: The fault is loose, unverified talk.
changed_reading.after: Each repetition acts like a thrown allegation claiming testimonial force, yet it arrives without the knowledge and witnesses required to carry that force.

context_deltas.mechanism: The report moves through a bound group, but collective circulation does not dissolve agency: each participant acquires a portion of guilt while one participant bears the main share. The plural mouths form a network with individually posted and asymmetrically distributed liability.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people anchors the networked act.
An encircling, mutually supporting group supplies the social topology.
Personal acquisition turns each participation into something posted to its agent.
Loading and counting guilt supplies the liability attached to acquisition.
The main bulk of an affair supplies asymmetric responsibility within the group.

structural_cues: Ayah 24:11 names a group, then allocates `لكل امرئ` a personal acquisition before singling out the bearer of the largest share.
The second-person plurals of 24:15 place multiple tongues and mouths inside that already differentiated group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies group cohesion, individual acquisition of guilt, and a largest share; I model the speakers as relay nodes and infer that diffusion does not dilute responsibility. Alternatively, the allocation may describe guilt without implying a transmission topology.

changed_reading.before: A crowd collectively passed on the report.
changed_reading.after: A bound group transmitted it, but every mouth acquired its own liability and the network retained an identifiable heavier node.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counterfactual responses route the report through hearing before speech: hearing should produce charitable judgment, identification of falsehood, and refusal to speak it. This exposes `تلقونه بألسنتكم` as a malformed reception path in which the tongue bypasses the listening and judging gate.

activation_trace.role: Taking up speech anchors the focus's abnormal reception stage.
Auditory reception supplies the proper bodily inlet before judgment.
The resulting utterance names the report as manifest falsehood instead of relaying it.
Hearing as understanding and responsive compliance supplies an interruptive uptake.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers is explicitly refused for this content.
A lie that overwhelms speaker or hearer supplies the classification that should halt transmission.

structural_cues: Both 24:12 and 24:16 repeat `إذ سمعتموه` before a required saying; 24:15 instead says `إذ تلقونه بألسنتكم`.
The counterfactual pipeline is hearing, evaluation, then corrective speech or refusal; the actual pipeline is tongue-reception, mouth-output, and absent knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel temporal clauses and contrasting organs and responses; I infer two competing reception pipelines. A live alternative is that `تلقونه` merely denotes rapid repetition without a deliberate ear-versus-tongue anatomy.

changed_reading.before: The speakers failed to verify what they heard.
changed_reading.after: They replaced hearing as an interpretive gate with tongue-level uptake, eliminating the pause in which falsehood could be recognized and speech refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding verbs render discourse as a medium that overflows and diffuses. The focus's tongue-to-mouth sequence is one local conduit in a collective expansion whose social spread is itself the consequential act.

activation_trace.role: Taking up speech supplies entry into each local conduit.
Speech spreading among people anchors the circulating output.
The expansion of speech and news like overflow supplies the hydraulic propagation mechanism.
Diffusion and widespread dispersal make social spread an explicit outcome.

structural_cues: The plural `أفضتم` immediately precedes the focus's plural oral verbs.
Ayah 24:19 later makes the spread of the obscenity, not only its first formulation, an object of desire and sanction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies discourse-overflow, oral conduits, and later diffusion; I join them into one propagation mechanism. They could instead be separate descriptions of discussion and of the allegation's broader social consequence.

changed_reading.before: Individuals repeated a rumor one after another.
changed_reading.after: Each tongue and mouth became an intake and discharge point in an expanding flow, so the offense included making the report socially pervasive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same tongue first appears as a supposedly passive channel and later as an autonomous witness concerning deeds. The bodily instrument reverses roles, turning ephemeral output into recoverable evidence against its operator.

activation_trace.role: The tongue as speech organ anchors the instrument used in the focus.
The tongue as witness supplies the explicit reversal from instrument to evidence.
The repeated bodily organ binds the later witness scene back to the focus anatomy.
Intentional deed classifies oral output as accountable action rather than vanishing sound.

structural_cues: Ayah 24:24 repeats `ألسنتهم` and coordinates tongues with hands and feet as witnesses.
Its testimony concerns what the speakers used to do, converting the focus's speech event into embodied action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact organ's recurrence and its later witness role; I infer retrospective relevance to the earlier misuse of tongues. The later testimony may also encompass deeds far beyond this report.

changed_reading.before: The tongue is a passive tool whose speech disappears after transmission.
changed_reading.after: The tongue records its own use: the channel that carried unsupported speech later returns as a witness that makes the act evidentially present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirage scene turns the focus's evaluative contrast into a temporal process: subjective reckoning mistakes appearance for substance, encounter dissolves the estimate, and the same root returns as complete accounting in God's presence.

activation_trace.role: Supposition anchors the focus's mistaken estimate of lightness.
Standing in God's presence anchors the forum that overturns the estimate.
A mirage appearing as water supplies the model of persuasive but empty valuation.
The first use supplies subjective supposition within the occurrence record that later turns to account.
The later account nouns convert private estimation into objective counting and settlement.
Finding nothing and then finding God supplies the collapse and replacement of the apparent object.
Presence at the object repeats the divine locus of true valuation.
Full completion without deficiency supplies the final settlement of the account.

structural_cues: In 24:39 one root occurrence record spans `يحسبه`, `حسابه`, and `الحساب`, making the shift from estimate to accounting packet-visible.
The sequence `وجده ... ووجد الله عنده فوفاه حسابه` restages the focus's movement from human reckoning to standing with God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared roots, mirage, failed finding, divine presence, and completed account; I infer that 24:39 materializes the focus's misvaluation mechanism. The mirage directly concerns deeds of disbelievers, so the analogy need not be exclusive to rumor.

changed_reading.before: Human and divine judgments simply disagree about the utterance's size.
changed_reading.after: The light estimate behaves like a mirage: it seems adequate only before encounter, then vanishes as subjective `حسب` becomes the fully settled `حساب` in God's presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later speech is tested by enacted alignment: a verbal claim to belief and obedience is negated by turning away, genuine believer-speech joins hearing to obedience, and strenuous oath is displaced by recognizable obedience known through action. Mouth-output is therefore not self-authenticating.

activation_trace.role: Externally produced speech anchors the focus's unsupported output.
Speech as professed belief supplies a verbal identity claim.
Heart-settling assent supplies what the verbal claim fails to establish by itself.
Obedient compliance supplies the action asserted by the mouth.
Turning away supplies behavior that falsifies the preceding verbal alignment.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies valid uptake.
Obedience immediately coupled to hearing supplies speech ratified by response.
A solemn oath supplies intensified mouth-output that is nevertheless refused.
Recognizable good supplies the requested alternative to verbal intensity.
Knowledge of the report's inward reality supplies divine access beyond claims.
Intentional action supplies the observable test of speech.

structural_cues: Ayah 24:47 places saying before a behavioral reversal and then denies the speakers' claimed identity.
Ayah 24:51 joins `سمعنا وأطعنا`, while 24:53 rejects maximal oath in favor of `طاعة معروفة` and closes with knowledge of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claim, reversal, responsive obedience, rejected oath, and known action; I infer a surah-wide authenticity test for mouth-speech. Alternatively, these later scenes concern covenantal obedience rather than the epistemic warrant of the earlier rumor.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns speech because its content was not known.
changed_reading.after: It also exposes mouth-speech as evidentially weak on its own: utterance becomes credible only when inward assent and enacted response align with it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later communication scene assigns a messenger, a bounded burden to each party, and clear delivery. It distinguishes accountable transmission from ownerless circulation: the focus does not condemn all relaying, but relaying severed from source, mandate, and carried responsibility.

activation_trace.role: Receiving and learning speech anchors the focus as a transmission event.
Messenger and message supply an identified source and authorized communicative role.
Bearing a trust or burden assigns distinct responsibility to sender and receivers.
Delivering a message supplies the legitimate endpoint of transmission.
Clarifying meaning by word or sign supplies transparency of content.

structural_cues: Ayah 24:54 distributes `ما حمل` and `ما حملتم` between messenger and audience before naming clear delivery.
This role-bounded chain contrasts with 24:15, where speech is taken up mouth-to-mouth with no knowledge named for its carriers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized messenger, separate burdens, and clear delivery; I contrast that chain with the focus's ungrounded relay and infer that provenance and role matter. The later verse primarily defines prophetic duty, so this contrast remains analogical.

changed_reading.before: Passing speech onward is itself the problem.
changed_reading.after: The problem is unaccountable transmission: legitimate delivery has a known source, a bounded trust, clear content, and named responsibility at each end.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the packet's `ق و ل` inventory splits to a form-distant `ق ل ل` target; it is not an ordinary derivation of `تقولون`. It remains anchored at that exact focus word and is reinforced by the explicit `هينا` versus `عظيم` reversal. Downstream prose should call it an experimental branch or sonic shadow, never the lexical meaning of the verb.

activation_trace.role: The split target's smallness and slightness cast an exploratory littleness shadow inside the act of saying.
Explicit lightness makes the form-distant shadow locally visible rather than free-floating.
Greatness supplies the verse's overt reversal of that littleness.

changed_reading.before: They spoke the report and separately judged it light.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory branch level, the saying itself carries a shadow of making-little that the verse immediately overturns as great.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading treats speech reception as boundary crossing, which is surprising because 24:27-28 literally regulate entry into houses. It remains anchored in the focus's intake and mouth-outlet construction and in the later sequence of entry, permission, and return. Render only as a spatial heuristic for epistemic custody, not as an equation between rumor law and house law.

activation_trace.role: Taking speech in supplies the focus's reception boundary.
The mouth as opening or outlet gives that boundary a bodily aperture.
Entry into an interior supplies the spatial analogue for admitting content.
The protected dwelling supplies a bounded interior rather than an open conduit.
Permission supplies a gatekeeping condition for crossing the boundary.
Returning what cannot enter supplies the alternative to automatic uptake.

changed_reading.before: The mouth receives and forwards whatever reaches it.
changed_reading.after: Speech intake can be imagined as entry into a protected interior: unsupported content lacks permission and should be turned back rather than housed and reissued.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately cross-domain meteorological activation: 24:43 describes clouds and rain, not rumor. It remains anchored in the focus's receive-and-emit chain because the packet supplies driving, joining, stacking, and issuing as one ordered material mechanism. Downstream prose should mark it as an analogy for emergent accumulation, not an asserted symbolic gloss.

activation_trace.role: Circulating speech anchors the social material to which the analogy is applied.
Gentle driving supplies movement of initially separate units.
Joining one thing to another supplies aggregation across relays.
Layered accumulation supplies emergent mass beyond any single contribution.
Falling rain supplies consequential discharge from the accumulated mass.
Passage to the outside supplies the mouth-like exit from accumulation.

changed_reading.before: Rumor propagation is a linear handoff between speakers.
changed_reading.after: Each small handoff can join and stack with others until collective speech condenses into a consequential discharge that no single mouth visually contains.

strongest_changes: The legal frame recasts unsupported repetition as evidence-bearing verbal accusation rather than merely careless conversation.
The repeated `إذ سمعتموه` clauses expose a proper hearing-and-judgment gate that tongue-level reception bypasses.
Overflow and diffusion turn plural mouths into a propagation medium while 24:11 preserves personal and asymmetric liability inside the group.
The later tongue-witness scene makes oral output an embodied deed that can return as evidence.
The mirage sequence develops `حسب` from fallible estimate into completed `حساب` in the same divine presence.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence connected anatomy, legal proof, social spread, action, and accounting without forcing them into one final interpretation. The focus ayah became simultaneously a malformed communication pipeline, an inadmissible accusation, a distributed liability event, and a collision between private estimate and divine reckoning.
remaining_uncertainties: The ear-versus-tongue pipeline may be a deliberate anatomical contrast or an intensified idiom for rapid repetition.
The mirage, permission, and cloud mechanisms are packet-anchored analogies, but their intended intra-surah force remains uncertain.
The `ق ل ل` activation under the split `ق و ل` inventory is form-distant experimental evidence and must not be treated as etymology.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Tongues act as relay hands while mouths act as outlets.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `ل ق ي` B011 is receiving or imparting speech and B005 casting something onward; `ل س ن` B001 is the speech organ and B002 taking someone with the tongue; `ف و ه` B001 is the mouth as opening and B003 uttering through it; `ع ل م` B001 is knowledge. **Structural cue:** the sequence is receive-with-tongues → say-with-mouths → lack knowledge, following 24:14's overflow and preceding 24:16's command not to speak. **Assigned role:** tongue and mouth form adjacent transfer stations that can move a report without a knowing subject ever taking responsibility for it. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies reception, outlet, and absent knowledge; I infer that frictionless oral handoff produces the spreading mechanism. **Reading change:** the ayah diagnoses circulation by organs, not simply individual belief in a false proposition.

2. **The moral failure includes a false scale.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `ه و ن` B002 is lightness/ease and B003 humiliation through treating something as insignificant; `ع ظ م` B001 is greatness and B007 finding something overwhelming; `ح س ب` B002 is mental reckoning. **Structural cue:** `تحسبونه هينا` is directly opposed to `عند الله عظيم`, and 24:13 has already placed judgment `عند الله`. **Assigned role:** the paired roots expose two incompatible measures of the same speech act. **Abductive move:** the packet gives human reckoning and divine valuation; I infer that easy transmission depends on discounting the weight borne by the target and community. **Reading change:** “light” names a corrupt valuation that enables relay, not merely ignorance of a rule.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 24:16-19 showed that the false scale is operational, not private: treating the report as light permits utterance, recurrence, and spread, whereas naming its greatness arrests the relay.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A norm becomes effective by being bounded, placed, counted, witnessed, and finally registered at its proper moral magnitude.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lexical branches make legislation spatial and corporeal: a surah resembles an enclosing wall, obligation a scored cut, punishment a measured impact on skin, and culpability an allocated share whose apparent and actual sizes diverge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mis-Scaled Moral Accounting
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Each participant acquires an individual liability, one actor shoulders its largest share, and speech judged light nearby is registered as great at the decisive station.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: the individual person `quranic:root_001409:B001/m01`; self-acquired gain or liability `quranic:root_001296:B001/m01`; the greatest portion of an affair `quranic:root_001281:B002/m01`; lightness and ease `quranic:root_001608:B002/m01`; magnitude and force `quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`; a grave descending event `quranic:root_001029:B004/m01`; nearness at a place of judgment `quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`; requital of sin `quranic:root_000013:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 24:11 `لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ ... مَا اكْتَسَبَ ... تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ`; 24:15 `تَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِندَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The rumor has an allocation structure: distributed acquisition, a largest share, and a final scale. What feels frictionless in the mouth becomes a weighty event at the adjudicating proximity marked by `عِندَ اللَّهِ`. The channel reframes casual transmission as measurable participation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 24:1-20] Speech Moves as a Physical Force
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An utterance can be launched, received, relayed, spilled, and intensified; social speech therefore behaves like force moving through material media.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The network materializes accusation as projectile injury and rumor as both fluid overflow and fire propagation, exposing distinct mechanisms rather than one generic “speech” domain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Accusation as Projectile Injury
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A verbal charge is launched toward a protected target, reaches listeners through abusive sound, and leaves a wound-like mark.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: launching an object `quranic:root_000603:B001/m01`; projectile, point, or struck quarry `quranic:root_000603:B003/m01`; verbal accusation `quranic:root_000603:B008/m01`; inaccurate shot of judgment `quranic:root_000603:B009/m01`; shield or practice target `quranic:root_000466:B005/m01`; abusive speech made audible `quranic:root_000741:B006/m01`; bodily wound `quranic:root_001316:B003/m01`; taking or attacking someone by the tongue `quranic:root_001355:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The charge inherits the mechanics of a shot: projection, target, possible mis-aim, reception, and injury. The protected person is not merely discussed but struck in a social body, while the tongue functions as the attacking instrument and hearing as the point of impact.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 24:1-20] Speech Moves as a Physical Force
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An utterance can be launched, received, relayed, spilled, and intensified; social speech therefore behaves like force moving through material media.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The network materializes accusation as projectile injury and rumor as both fluid overflow and fire propagation, exposing distinct mechanisms rather than one generic “speech” domain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tongue-to-Mouth Relay
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Speech is taken at one bodily interface and immediately reissued from another, producing a relay without a knowledge-bearing pause.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tongue as speech organ `quranic:root_001355:B001/m01`; tongue as message carrier `quranic:root_001355:B008/m01`; receiving and learning words `quranic:root_001372:B011/m01`; mouth as opening `quranic:root_001190:B001/m01`; opening the mouth in speech `quranic:root_001190:B003/m01`; voiced utterance `quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`; auditory reception `quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The verse's unusual tongue reception becomes a literal transfer mechanism in the branch network. Words are caught, carried, and emitted through organs of speech before knowledge enters the circuit, explaining how repetition can outrun verification.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 24:1-20] Speech Moves as a Physical Force
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An utterance can be launched, received, relayed, spilled, and intensified; social speech therefore behaves like force moving through material media.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The network materializes accusation as projectile injury and rumor as both fluid overflow and fire propagation, exposing distinct mechanisms rather than one generic “speech” domain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Discourse as Overflow
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A filled source spills beyond its boundary, and the released material diffuses as circulating talk.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: liquid filling and easy overflow `quranic:root_001192:B001/m01`; expansive immersion in talk `quranic:root_001192:B003/m01`; diffusion among people `quranic:root_000836:B003/m01`; circulating public talk `quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Overflow and rumor share one process signature: pressure exceeds containment, then material disperses through a population. The hydrological image clarifies that the wrong is not only the proposition's content but the uncontrolled expansion of its carrier medium.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 24:1-20] Cognition Can Align or Invert a Report
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Before speech becomes public judgment, the mind estimates, orients, and either aligns a report with evidence or turns it away from truth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The branches distinguish several epistemic operations concealed by broad labels such as “thinking”: strong inference, weak imagining, accusation, habitual suspicion, internal speech, and directional inversion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Gradient from Inference to Suspicion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A heard report moves through increasingly unstable mental estimates, from inference by a sign to weak imagining, accusation, and habitual mistrust.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: conviction inferred from an indicator `quranic:root_000969:B001/m01`; weak supposition `quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`; accusatory suspicion `quranic:root_000969:B004/m01`; habitual ill opinion of others `quranic:root_000969:B005/m01`; estimating something in the mind `quranic:root_000318:B002/m01`; believing a report so the heart settles `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 24:11 `لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا`; 24:12 `سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ... خَيْرًا`; 24:15 `تَحْسَبُونَهُ هَيِّنًا`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is a decision ladder, not a single state called opinion. The same input may be interpreted through a trustworthy indicator, held as weak conjecture, converted into an accusation, or generalized into a disposition toward others. The commanded good judgment is therefore an active epistemic choice.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 24:1-20] Cognition Can Align or Invert a Report
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Before speech becomes public judgment, the mind estimates, orients, and either aligns a report with evidence or turns it away from truth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The branches distinguish several epistemic operations concealed by broad labels such as “thinking”: strong inference, weak imagining, accusation, habitual suspicion, internal speech, and directional inversion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Inner Speech Meets Exposed Knowledge
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Unvoiced formulation and inward intention are contrasted with articulated disclosure and knowledge that fully uncovers its object.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: speech formed internally before utterance `quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`; speech as held conviction or doctrine `quranic:root_001272:B013/m01`; mind, intention, and discriminating faculty within the self `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`; knowledge as the object's disclosure to the knower `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; meaning exposed through word or sign `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; right-aiming wisdom `quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 24:12 `بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ... وَقَالُوا`; 24:15 `مَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلْمٌ`; 24:18-19 `يُبَيِّنُ ... عَلِيمٌ ... اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The decisive boundary lies between what the self formulates, what the mouth releases, and what is actually known. Disclosure is legitimate when it unveils meaning; rumor instead externalizes an inner formulation without the corresponding disclosure of fact.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sexual accusation reaches beyond an isolated act into pairing, marital legitimacy, conception, gestation, birth, and the traces by which lineage becomes socially visible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Womb, postpartum blood, afterbirth, birth witness, midwife, and rapid conception branches disclose the lineage stakes that make sexual testimony unusually consequential.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gestation and Birth Leave Evidence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A womb receives conception, carries a child, releases birth material, and is attended by recognizable traces and a receiving agent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: womb as the child's growing enclosure `quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`; pregnancy and postpartum emergence `quranic:root_001533:B005/m01`; blood or membrane accompanying birth as a witness `quranic:root_000822:B006/m01`; afterbirth and uterine discharge `quranic:root_000994:B009/m01`; midwife receiving the newborn `quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`; rapid conception `quranic:root_001372:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The branch network assembles a complete reproductive sequence from roots otherwise active in mercy, selfhood, witness, punishment, reception, and verbal relay. This scene usefully reframes why proof rules guard lineage: birth itself yields bodily witnesses, while rumor tries to manufacture social evidence without them.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yüzde ortaya çıkan ve yüzü ya da ağız köşesini eğrilten bir hastalığı açıkça tanımlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi hastalığı, etkilenen bölgeyi ve görünür sonucu birlikte korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel eğrilik ya da yüz biçimi değil, yüzde eğrilik oluşturan hastalıkla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, hastalığın kendisini ve bu hastalığa tutulmuş kişiyi kapsar; başka kullanımlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yüzde ortaya çıkarak yüzün veya ağız köşesinin eğrilmesine yol açan bir hastalıktır.

facets.statement: Hastalık yüzde ortaya çıkar ve yüzün doğal görünümünü bozar.
Bozulma özellikle ağız köşesinin ya da yüzün eğrilmesi biçiminde görünür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar bunun yüzde görülen bir hastalık olduğu konusunda birleşir; ayrıntılı anlatım hastalığın ağız köşesini veya yüzü eğrilttiğini belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: yüzü veya ağız köşesini eğrilten hastalık
concept_gloss.applicability: Hastalığın yeri ile oluşturduğu biçim bozukluğunun birlikte anlatılması gereken genel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzdeki hastalığı ve bunun yol açtığı eğrilmeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güncel dilde yüzün bir yanını ve ağız köşesini çarpıtan hastalığın kısa karşılığı olarak kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzde işlev ve biçim bozukluğu yapan bir hastalık düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynak ifadesi felcin çağdaş tıbbi nedenini veya türünü açıkça belirlemez.
error_profile.collision: Çağdaş tıpta belirli sinir hasarı türleriyle özdeşleştirilebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kanıt iki ayrı adı aynı dalda toplar: kuyuda salındığında başka bir kovayı kaldıran kova ile gagası eğri veya ağız açıklığı geniş olduğu için böyle adlandırılan dişi kartal.

facets.statement: Bir kullanım, kuyuya salınırken başka bir kovayı yukarı kaldıran kovayı adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.
